methodology: Frame cadence measures requestAnimationFrame intervals, not verified physical display presentation.
Baseline and intermediate rows below are transcribed summaries from Chrome measurements in this task. finalSamples are exported directly from the final browser run.
No draw/far/near/sky isolation is active in final measurements. Production workers produce authored exterior meshes without the earlier experimental replacement script.
Final settings were saved through the game UI and verified in a fresh tab. The 20-second final sample excludes shader/terrain warm-up.
360-degree tests each sample 8 seconds after 1.5-second warm-up. Rapid turns add vertical sweeps and can show less geometry when looking up or down.
Movement test travels out and back over 16 seconds, reaching +48m X, +32m Z, +24m Y. It restores the player position and flying state.
Measurements describe this scene and hardware. Short spikes remain; average FPS over 100 is not a guarantee that every frame finishes in 10ms.
